question: How do simple adjustment choices and sampling uncertainty affect the decision supported by a public experimental contrast?
disclosure: Prospective specification for this new calculation, not historical preregistration. Published unadjusted estimate about 1794 is known from source inspection.
target: Average assignment effect on 1978 earnings for the retained male RE74 experimental subset, conditional on the original design and subset-selection assumptions
units: Archived real-earnings dollar units; no conversion to current dollars
assumptions: Random assignment preserved by the documented selection on pre-intervention variables
No interference and consistent treatment meaning
Observed earnings and selected records represent the retained target; no undocumented differential selection
Normal approximation with fixed low-dimensional covariates and bounded influence is adequate; no exact finite-sample coverage claim
primary: Difference in means with separate-arm variance and 95 percent normal interval
comparators: Fully interacted OLS centred at the full-sample covariate mean with HC2 covariance
No intervention at illustrative cost thresholds

defaults.covariates: All eight documented pretreatment fields, frozen without outcome selection
defaults.scaling: Centre and divide by full-sample standard deviation for numerical conditioning; invariant to units
defaults.uncertainty: HC2 leverage adjustment; HC3 is a sensitivity, neither supplies exact coverage

conditional_situations: Zero 1975 earnings versus positive 1975 earnings: descriptive subgroup contrasts, no multiplicity-adjusted selection claim
High leverage and heavy-tailed earnings: HC3 and leave-one-out sensitivity

promotion_criteria: Data matches author sample and target
promotion_veto: No causal claim if assignment/selection premises unsupported
No superiority from a single observed standard error
No economically positive recommendation when the lower interval crosses the specified cost
continuation_veto: Corrupt data or missing indispensable fields
explanatory: Difference between mirror and author bytes

sensitivity: For a stipulated absolute bias bound B, expand the interval to [L-B,U+B]; this is conditional sensitivity, not a data-identified confounding correction.
economic_interpretation: Compare the observed earnings contrast to illustrative per-person costs in the same archival units. This is not bank ROI, a social cost-benefit analysis or an actual programme budget.
software: Project NumPy/SciPy implementation, checked against separate-arm regressions and direct sample-moment arithmetic. No external causal-package benchmark.
interfaces: Send actual estimator summaries and their covariance to the existing library/CLI/MCP Gaussian moment interface; report-building remains local, not an implemented report.build claim.
limits: Original assignment logs, site/month design and complete cohort unavailable
No empirical coverage measurement from one realised experiment
Data-specific commercial redistribution rights unresolved; local methodological research only
